title: Mapo Tofu
description: A classic Sichuan dish made with tofu, ground meat, and chili peppers. This mapo tofu recipe is a staple of Chinese cuisine.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm or soft, whichever is available

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add sliced chili peppers and cook until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spatula.
Add garlic, ginger, and chili oil. Cook until fragrant.
Add tofu and stir-fry until it's golden brown.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch (if using). Pour the mixture into the wok or skillet.
Stir-fry for another minute, until the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
